published_source: Printed Table 3, column (1) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2020.3707.pdf, pp. 4650-4651), read Nov 4 2026: IDD 0.008** with the p-value (0.016) in parentheses (p-values based on state-clustered robust standard errors; no SE printed, so published_se = null), Observations 123,212, R2 0.162, region x year FE and firm FE, no controls; equals the authors' code output 0.0079391 (SE 0.0031983, p 0.0165), N 123,212, to the printed decimals. Earlier: no published_source field; the published 0.008 (p = 0.016), N 123,212 came from the screening record (accepted-manuscript PDF), see notes and the replication log.
replication_status: exact (authors' code output 0.0079391 (0.0031983, p 0.0165), N 123,212, equals printed Table 3 column (1) 0.008 (p 0.016; no SE printed), N 123,212, to the printed decimals; Stata reghdfe and fixest agree; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: Authors: reghdfe acquisition idd, absorb(firm regionn##fyear) vce(cluster hstate) on MainSample.dta; published 0.008 (p = 0.016, SE not printed), N = 123,212, R2 = 0.162. Replicated in Stata/reghdfe and fixest: 0.0079391 (SE 0.0031983, p = 0.0165, N = 123,212 after 782 singletons, R2 = 0.1620) = exact. Prepared data (mainsample_prepared.rds, built by prep.R in ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2020.3707/) adds g_firm = firm-level first-treatment year: 1980 if idd = 1 in the firm's first observed year (4,030 always-treated firms, incl. late entrants into IDD states), the state adoption year or first observed idd = 1 year otherwise (1,475 firms in 12 state cohorts 1982-2006 plus 453 HQ movers whose idd switches on at the move), NA for 5,164 never-treated firms. drop_so flags 6,442 post-adoption rows with idd = 0 (FL 2002+, MI 2003+, TX 2004+ rejections, and moves out of IDD states; 879 firms); sample_filter removes them per protocol (Hull fn 6). On that sample the authors' TWFE is 0.0123091 (SE 0.0048941 clustered on time-varying hstate; N = 116,725). Cluster: hstate_firm = firm's modal HQ state, because did::att_gt rejects time-varying cluster variables; hstate varies for 1,144 firms. regionn stored as a factor (Census region, time-varying for 756 movers) and entered as xt (region x year FE in TWFE/BJS, region dummies as covariates in CSA).
